dataset_name: Kauaʻi Public Events and Clubs Register

event_window.note: One-time events are limited primarily to currently published upcoming 2026 listings. Recurring community happenings and clubs may continue beyond this window.

methodology.method: Manual public-web aggregation and normalization from indexed calendars, official venue pages, public library listings, county pages, club sites, and publicly indexed Meetup pages.
limitations: Private Facebook groups, Nextdoor, closed mailing lists, unindexed flyers, login-gated calendar views, and ephemeral social stories are not comprehensively represented.
Event details can change after publication. The source URL and verification date are retained for refresh workflows.
Some public boards contain conflicting or malformed times; those records are flagged instead of silently normalized.
Addresses are included only where they were public or could be tied to a verified venue page.
recommended_matchbook_use: Treat this as seed data, not as a permanent source of truth.
Store source URL, last_checked, confidence, and verification notes with every imported record.
Create refresh jobs for official calendars and organizer self-service claiming/submission.
Place low- and medium-confidence records in a moderation queue before public release.

conflicts_and_follow_up.name: Private and login-gated boards
conflicts_and_follow_up.issue: Facebook groups, private Instagram stories, Nextdoor, email newsletters, church bulletins, and unindexed flyers cannot be comprehensively scraped from the public web.
conflicts_and_follow_up.recommended_action: Add organizer self-submission, calendar-feed imports, and a human moderation queue to MatchBook.
